correctness.rationale: PASS. The combinatorial counterexample was reconstructed independently. The four-parallel-edge graph has genus 3, no bridges or cut vertex, valence 4 at both weight-zero vertices, and the degree-one canonical polarization is (1/2,1/2) and nondegenerate. Exhaustive quasistable pseudo-divisor enumeration gives exactly 32 classes with rank distribution 4,12,12,4 and maximum rank 3. Because the two tropical curves use the same graph and polarization, the face-poset data are identical; under the RESULT's explicitly stated combinatorial-polyhedral-complex notion, the complexes are isomorphic. Their single metric blocks are not isomorphic because the edge-length multisets (1,1,1,1) and (1,1,1,2) differ. The Jacobian-volume check 4 versus 7 independently confirms metric information is lost. This does not prove equivalence under a stricter metric/isometric notion of polyhedral complex.
